Class CartItem

java.lang.Object
CartItem
public class CartItem extends Object
One drink in the cart, with the options picked in the Drink Customization dialog.

A cart item stores the selected menu item and its customization choices. The price methods calculate the cost of one customized drink and the complete line item, respectively.
